# Ai-Memory-Free

> Free MIT-licensed, LLM-agnostic memory for any AI project. Self-deploy to a
> user-owned Supabase project; connect through HTTPS, TypeScript, or MCP.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/BizrnrAI/Ai-Memory-Free
Creator: Kristian Peter, Chief Automation Officer
Creator site: https://kristianpeter.com
License: MIT; no required licensing fee
Telemetry: none

## Start

- AI entry point: ./AI.md
- Paste-to-agent install prompt: ./INSTALL_WITH_AI.md
- Complete AI install contract: ./docs/AI_AGENT_INSTALL.md
- Documentation index: ./docs/INDEX.md
- Quick start: ./README.md

## Technical Contract

- Architecture: ./docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
- Security and Supabase Vault: ./docs/SECURITY.md
- MCP: ./docs/MCP.md
- Operations: ./docs/OPERATIONS.md
- Exact replication: ./docs/REPLICATE.md
- Canonical implementation guide: ./docs/ZERO_COST_SSOT_MEMORY.md

The memory stores and retrieves ranked evidence. The calling model performs
reasoning and synthesis. Do not store credentials in semantic memory.
